description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler with virtual methods for handling container events such as start, stop, failure, and state change, using JSON data structures.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface class for handling container lifecycle events, with methods to be implemented for reacting to container start, stop, failure, and state change events.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container starts, with event data provided as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, with event data provided as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container fails, with event data provided as a JSON object.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container's state changes, with event data provided as a JSON object.
